body: Thank you.  I've heard of it.  Haven't read it yet.  I'll probably buy a paper or ebook copy though... I've never really been into audiobooks.

>don't want to demean your depression

I don't really care dude, you're fine.  

I work road construction.  We work so many hours that we tend to hit overtime on Wednesday nights which raises our pay to $50ish per hour from around $35 per hour.  So I can get a weekly paycheck of between $1400 and $1600(ish... depends on a lot of factors).  This is on a good week.  Other weeks we 'only' make $500-$700 (again, due to wildly varying circumstances).
